import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix label variant in 'island' (trim spaces and correct ' Biscoe' to 'Biscoe')
    df["island"] = df["island"].str.strip()
    df.loc[df["island"] == " Biscoe", "island"] = "Biscoe"
    
    # Parse 'body_mass_g' as numeric, remove invalid rows
    df["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(df["body_mass_g"], errors="coerce")
    df = df.dropna(subset=["body_mass_g"])
    df = df[(df["body_mass_g"] >= 2500) & (df["body_mass_g"] <= 6500)]
    
    # Keep only rows with known sex (drop missing sex)
    df = df.dropna(subset=["sex"])
    
    # Keep only allowed species and islands (optional, but not required by question)
    allowed_species = {"Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"}
    allowed_islands = {"Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"}
    df = df[df["species"].isin(allowed_species)]
    df = df[df["island"].isin(allowed_islands)]
    
    # Keep id column
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by 'sex', compute mean body_mass_g
    grouped = df.groupby("sex").mean()
    result = {}
    for label, val in grouped["body_mass_g"].items():
        result[label] = round(val, 1)
    # If no groups, use 'all'
    if not result:
        result["all"] = df["body_mass_g"].mean() if not df.empty else None
    return result
